tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rin chen don 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// addhūtamant+ritabasantamamītatsāryaḥkalpātrapādaradzahipraṇidhohalāsyā// ༄༅// rmad byung spyod pa dpag yas dpyid du mgron gnyer ba// smon lam sgeg mo'i rkang rdul bkod pas bskal pa 'dir// protphullakarm+mabipulaṃdalahībitsinta/ shshāstāgrapūdzanamashokadzinasyamūrdhe// bsam gyis mi khyab phrin las 'dab ma yangs phye ba// ston mchog rgyal ba'i mya ngan med pa gtsug na mchod// tshangs pa'i bu mo dar bab mgrin pa longs spyod kyi// 'khor lo la dgyes bag mar khugs pa'i dga' ston du// sangs rgyas rtogs brjod snyan dngags glu ru 'jo ba la// dge dbang yab sras mkhas pa'i zla 'od srid na dkar// de yi tshig don zab brling yongs 'du'i 'khri shing gi /yal 'dab ji snyed 'khrungs par gyur pa'i grangs de snyed// tshigs bcad me tog gsar du 'dzum pa gus sbyor gyi// srad bu la bstar bsod nams sa bon 'jog phyir yin// bskal pa'i phreng bar tshogs bsags chu bo'i gter// rmad byung spyod pa'i gzings chen gyis brgal nas// yon tan rin chen mdzod la dbang 'byor ba// don gnyis grub pa'i ded dpon shākya thub// ma 1 ngon 'dod rtse dga' dran pa'i gnyis 'thung gis// dbang med khyer ba las brtsams gtam dag gis// sems nyid bslab pas 'dul la mkhas pa'i mchog /'thob phyir byang chub thugs bskyed rab gsal can// lu 2 sa phyed bcad pa'i bram zer sku yi smad// sog les dral te stsal la ya mchan skyes// brgya byin zil mngar gyis bran rnal du bkod// sdug pa'i mchis 'brang yang thob dpal gyi sde// ba 3 tsun mo lha sras bcas dang rang lus sha /lhan skyes gtsug gi nor rnams slong la byin// bden tshig stsal gyis rang lus snga mkhor gnas// rgyal srid dpal bcas thob pa gtsug nor bu//

4 bde gshegs mchod pa'i rnam dkar ti la ka /gnam bskos lus su rdzogs pa'i 'jo sgeg gis// gling bzhi sum cu gsum bcas brtan pa dag /rang dbang bgyid pa'i 'khor sgyur nga las nu// mdzes 5 sku zla gzhon 'od kyi drwa ba dang*// gtong phod yi ge dkar por dgod pa'i dpal// dbrog phyir lhags pa'i bram zer sa bdag dbu// lha mis ma bzlog byin pa zla ba'i 'od// chom 6 rkun nor gyis tshim dka'i sdug bsngal brten// bgrod dka'i mtsho gling snying stobs chen pos phyin// nor bu'i tshogs blangs skye 'gro'i rgud pa bcil// shin tu dga' bas ba da ra gling bgrod// 'bangs 7 mor gyur pas skyo bar kun mkhyen gyis// byin brlabs tshe 'phos rgyal rigs bu mor skyes// dad pa'i gzhi brling bris sku mthong ba'i rgyus// rgyun zhugs mngon gyur mu tig 'khri shing can// gnyen 8 gyi bu yis bslab ltar zas gtsang sras// dug can zas la mgron gnyer me dong gi /bzhugs gnas padmar gyur pa'i khrir bzhugs tshe// 'gyod tshangs bgyis pa'i sdig bral dpal sbas so// rgyal 9 bas khye'ur lung bstan zad byed kyis// bslus pa'i rab bzang chung ma bkums pa'i ro// bsregs pa las skyes gang gis 'byor pa'i tshogs// yongs btang srid pa'i dgra rgyal me las skyes// sri 10 da pa'i sa bon gnas skabs lngas rdzogs pa// skye rga na 'chi'i gom stabs rim bsgyur la// kun 'byung grib ma 'bral med rjes 'brang ba// 'gog lam bsten pa mngal nas 'byung ba'i gtam// chags 11 ldan lus la ston pas rab byung stsal// yid ni 'dod pa'i shing rtas rab drangs pa// lha yul dpal dang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dag /nyer bstan chags pa'i rdul bral mdzes dga' bo// yab 12 kyi rgyal srid sdig pa'i sems kyis phrogs// bden mthong shākya'i rigs rnams yongs brlag pa'i// 'bras bu rgyal blon lhan cig me nang du// tshig nas mnar med lhung ba 'phags skyes po// gzhan

13 gyi phru gu btsas dgu'i srog dbugs dag /phrogs pa'i bcud myang sdig las ldog phyir du// de bzhin gshegs pas bu gcig bsgribs byas pa'i// gdung bas bslab gzhi blangs pa 'phrog ma'i gtam// cho 'phrul 14 ya ma zung bstan bcom ldan 'das// 'dab stong rgyal skus mtshan pa grangs med dbus// chos sgra 'byin la 'gran 'dod ston pa drug /rdzu 'phrul mthu nyams bros pa'i cho 'phrul che// lha 15 mchog lha yi don mdzad 'dzam gling gi /skye 'gros zhus ngor lha tshogs grangs med bcas// gsal ldan grong du babs par utpa las// 'khor sgyur zol gyis skabs phye lha las babs// ku 16 sha'i grong khyer gshegs lam phyag dar tshe// gyad stobs stong gis ma bskyod rdo mo che// zhabs mdzub kyis phyung phyag gis ring du 'phangs// ye shes dbugs kyis bshig bsdoms brag 'phangs pa// nyi 17 ma'i gnyen mchog gru yi zam stegs las// gaṅgā'i pha rol phyin pa'i sa 'og nas// rin chen mchod sdong thon bstan rnam 'dren gyi// nyi ma zung 'char byams pa lung du bstan// dbul 18 mos mar me phul bar byang chub mchog /lung bstan de 'drar 'dod pa'i gsal rgyal ngor// gtong phod che dang gzhan la phan pa brgyas// byang chen bsgrub dka'i dper bstan me long bzhin// sngon 19 skyer sems rgyud gshin pa'i sa gzhi la// rnam dkar smon lam sa bon btab las skyes// dus 'dir rnam par 'byed pa'i dbang phyug la// bsil bar thob pa shā ri'i bu rab byung*// nor bu 20 phal pa don gnyer ring 'phyan pas// nyin mtshan bde sdug 'bras bu re mos spyod// mthong bas kā tyā yān las zhi ba thob// bde gshegs kyis bsngags gro bzhin byi ba rna// klu 21 shing sdong po las skyes yid 'phrog mig /ri mo'i gzugs la gtod tshe gzugs can snying*// sngon gyi smon lam gyis bkug rtse dga' la// rnam par rtsen pa'i bu btsas a mra skyong*// sangs

22 rgyas dad pa'i zas sbyin pas yi rin// gser gyis gshibs nas gtsug lag khang bskrun la// mig dmar rdzu 'phrul co 'drir shā ri'i bus// gnyen pos pham byas rgyal byed tshal de bzung*// zas 23 gtsang pho nya rim btang rab byung mthar// 'char kas mtshams sbyar n+ya gro dha brtsigs nas// ston pa lha yi tshogs bcas mkha' las byon// khang bzang shel sprul yab sras mjal ba'i gtam// rin chen 24 glang po slong ba la byin pas// skyed byed khros pas yul gzhan spyugs gyur kyang*// bu dang chung ma bdog pa kun btang bas// brgya byin rang gzugs kyis bstod thams cad sgrol// sgyu 'a 25 phrul lhums zhugs padma ltar bltams nas// sgyu rtsal legs bstan rgyal thabs skyong ba'i tshe// rga na 'chi dang thar pas yid byung nas// thabs brgyas ma bzlog mkha' la mngon par 'byung*// chu 26 klung 'gram ngogs dka' spyad rdo rje'i gdan// rtswa 'tshong gis phul ku sha bkram stengs su// mi phyed mnyam gzhag mdzes sdug sgyu rtsal dang*// bdud sde'i dmag tshogs mnyam nyid dbyings su btul// rgyal 27 ba'i yon tan gyis mtho sngon byung gtam// gleng bar thub dbang mes pos byin brlabs pas// maung gal bu yi skal ldan shing rta de// shākya'i che brjod gaṅgā 'bebs la mkhas// pang 28 skyes nyi ma brtol byung gro bzhin skyes// ro brgya'i bshos phul ston par bstabs lhag gis// gzugs can snying po mgu nas sangs rgyas drung*// rjes khrid rnam grol bye ba nyi shu pa// phyag 29 'os 'dod pa'i lhas byin dug chu yis// myos pa'i gsod byed bkye ba kun mkhyen gyi// phyag sor las 'thon gdong lngas bskrad de slar// zhugs kyi lcags ris yongs bskor nor skyong btul// skye 30 gnas gcig gyur bzod pa'i rang bzhin la// chos phyir btsun mo'i tshogs kyis dad byas par// log lta dus sa'i ral gris yongs gtubs pa// bden pa'i tshig gis rnal gnas kā shi mdzes// nags

31 su ri dwags tshogs bskyang bder gnas tshe// nyal 'gro'i rgyun khyer mi bsrun pha rol bsgral// mi smra dam bcas nor phyir dral ba'i rgyus// rgyal khab spyan drangs chos smra gser gyi logs// chu 32 gter la zhugs nor bcas 'ong ba'i lam// gru bo che zhig nu bo bsgral lan du// 'dren byed nor bcas phrogs kyang 'khon spangs pa'i// bden pas rnal du gnas de dge byed mthu// bkres 33 kyang sdig pa ma brtsams sha khrag gis// bsos pa'i chung mas log g.yems g.yo thabs kyis// nyam nga'i g.yang du bskyur yang ma nongs par// rgyal srid thob pa khyad par lo mar grags// lhun 34 po lan gsum 'khyud pa'i lag 'gro zung*// maung gal bu yis sgyu 'phrul klus bcings tshe// bros par mi 'jigs mchog sbyin ston mchog la// skyabs su 'gro byas dga' bo nyer dga' btul// 35 mtshan mor me 'od sangs rgyas bka' bklags pas// me khrims dral te btson chud me 'od 'khyil// phyi nas gsal rgyal ma btud chad pa yang*// bsod nams mthu yis grol ba legs byin can// 'char 36 byed sdig par bskul yang ma brtsams par// bsdigs pa'i zol gyis rnam bskrad sbyin pa'i gtam// bsnyad pa'i grogs dang 'grogs nas ston pa'i gsung*// legs thos gtsug lag khang brtsigs gdangs can pa// don mthun 37 sangs rgyas skyabs su 'gro ba'i glus// spu long rab rgyas ston pa'i spyan sngar phyin// rab byung dgra bcom tshong pa gru 'jig gis// gsol btab 'phral la 'jigs bskyabs gang po mchog /rgyal 38 srid 'byor pa'i kā shi mdzes dga' mor// yid 'byung smra ba bskyungs pa'i snying ring grogs// dben pa'i rtse dga' rjes su dran pa'i blo// mi 'gyur dka' thub spyod pa lkugs 'phyer grags// 39 btsun mo'i tshogs kyis dad la log lta'i khrag /sbags pa'i ral gris drang srong yan lag rnams// dum bur phral ba'i 'bras bu mnar med ltung*// khro bral bden pas bsos pa'i bzod dga' mdzes// tshig

40 rtsub ser char drag pos sdug bsngal gyi// 'bab chu brgal dga'i gnas 'phangs chu srin gzugs// bco brgyad mgo bo gdengs pas ston par gus// lhar 'phos chos kyi mig thob ser skya'o// rin 41 chen go cha'i skyes lan rgyal ba'i sku// ri mor shar ba mthong 'phral dad pa'i rgyus// rgyal thabs spangs nas dngos mjal legs gsungs kyis// rnam grol las mngon bgyis pa u drā yan// bkres 42 rngabs dar dus dbul phongs lnga brgya phrag /sa 'og gter byin thub pa'i bka' lung mnos// bdog dgu sbyin par bstabs nas rab tu byung*// yul rkyen la brten dgra bcom mkhas par grags// yul 43 phyogs mu ge las bsrungs sbyin gtong gis// bang mdzod 'god pa la zad lhag ma'i zas// chung ngu rang sangs rgyas la phul ba'i 'phral// zas nor 'dod dgur 'jo ba gser gyi mdog /las 44 bzang lag pa rin chen padma las// nangs rer dngul dkar nyis 'bum 'dzag rdul gyis// slong rnams tshim byas ston pa'i legs gsungs mnos// chags bral slong ba'i snod thogs gser gyi lag /lhas 45 byin gros bzhin pha gcig khri mun du// bcug nas bkums pas nyam nga'i dong lhung ba// mthol tshangs dam pa'i dpyangs thag la 'khyud de// bde ba'i khang bzang phyin pa ma skyes dgra// lhas 46 byin dug gi sen mos 'debs sems kyis// bde gshegs spyan sngar phyin 'phral dmyal bar ltung*// sngon yang byas mi shes dus rab gtses kyang*// rang gi khyad par mngon mtho byas pa shes// ston 47 pa'i mdun gnas klu chen bzhi dag gis/ gsal rgyal bkur stir ma byas khros lan du// rdo char phab pa zas gyur sā la'i phreng*// bu ram shing smin sā la'i sdong bur grags// 'byor 48 dgu rdzogs kyang dbul po gzhan gyi dbang*// gdengs can grong nas yid bzhin nor blangs pa// chu lhas phrogs pa snying stobs kyis drangs te// ci 'dod char du 'jo ba don kun grub// phan

49 tshun las kyi lag sbrel mdza' na mo// 'gugs byed lhan skyes gser gyi glang po las// mche ba zung blangs gsal rgyal phul lan du// bu mo thob mthar rnam grol glang po can// rdzing 50 bu gdung ba med par mi mchog gis// mchog zung rdzu 'phrul gyis lhags dge 'dun dbus// rnam 'dren gzugs sku'i mkha' dkyil dwangs par yang*// bcu phrag las kyi gzha' ris bkrag por bstan// 51 dbul mo btsas shing ltogs mas phru gu yang*// bza' bar brtsam la rang gi nu 'bur gnyis// byin la 'gyod pa skyes snyam brgya byin mdun// bden pas skyes bu'i lus bsgyur gser ldan ma// slong 52 ba'i dpag bsam gcod pa'i dgra dpung la// snying rjes rgyal srid yongs btang nags su song*// nongs chen bskyab phyir rang lus dgra la byin// dgra zlas gtsug bkur bsod nams mi dman pa// legs 53 bshad gsar pa mnyan phyir sha wa rir// mu tig do shal phul nas chos thos mthar// bla ma 'khyog po'i bka' ltar nyam nga'i g.yang*// mchongs pa gnod sbyin gyis bsrungs legs bshad 'tshol// 'tsho 54 ba'i dus na mi bzad bro 'tshal ba// thams cad bde bar sbyar la ya mtshan ci// rnam shes mtho ris 'phos pa'i bems pos kyang*// 'gro ba'i nad sel sems can sman gyi mthu// sha 55 wa ris gtses phug ron srog bskyab phyir// rang lus sha tshogs zad par srong bcal yang*// 'tshob par ma nus lus rdzogs gzhal ba'i sems// bden pa'i mthu yis rnal gnas thams cad ster// mi 56 phyugs lo tog gzhom pa'i dug can gyi// 'gro 'dul kha lo sgyur mthong rdo rje'i char// drag por phab pa me tog phreng gyur pas// dad pas skyabs song ba lang skyong klu btul// ring 57 bsrel snying pos sbrum pa 'od 'bar rten// mgul gyi dril chung dam chos glur 'jo ba// legs gsungs thos pa'i skal bzang lha dang mir// bskrun du bcug pa'i bde gshegs mchod rten phreng*// lus

58 can nad kyi gdung ba bdag snying la// 'phos pa lta bu'i rim gro lhur len tshe// dmus long tshul la lta byed legs stsal bas// brgya byin ngo mtshar spyan bsos bsod nams stobs// las 59 bzang 'bras bu yid srubs gzugs kyi ro// btung byar ma thob g.yem mas mig phyung yang*// pi wang snyan pa'i klus 'tsho rang gnas phyin// khro med bden pa'i mig thob ku la la// bye tshan 60 rnon pos btab pas lus med thul// skyabs kyi dam par legs bzung chu gter klong*// gtsug lag khang mang sprul nas spyan drangs mchod// byang chub mchog tu lung bstan gzhon nu'i klu// 61 bram ze khyo shug zung gis lha yi lhar// gtsang ma'i zhal zas kyis bstabs 'byor ldan du// smon lam btab mthus gser gyi ljang bu skyes// mi mchog mchod pa'i chags bral zhing sa nyid// bu med 62 n+ya gro dha yi lhar bsdigs pas// des kyang lha dbang gsol btab legs bris bu// tshe 'phos 'phral du bu skal byin pa de// ston pa'i drung son dgra bcom grags pa sbyin// mdzes 63 sdug gser 'dra chos kyi mdza' na mo// thob kyang gnyis ka chags bral gnas pas gnas// snum 'khur 'tshir ba'i sdig pas yid skyo nas// srid pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal 'od srungs che// yid

64 'phrog lus phra lhan cig rtse dga'i ro// 'thung ba'i gegs ni blo ngan gyis brtsams pas// mi'am ci mo bros pa spro ba brgyas// mthar gyis rang yul khugs pa nor bzang lha// ri dwags 65 bu mo las skyes thub pa'i bu// nags su mtshar sdug bzhin zla rgyas pa de// pad gdan 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal gyis drangs te// kun gyi spyi bor dbang bskur rwa gcig pa// gsod 66 par btang bas nya pa'i khyim nang du// sgyu rtsal kun rdzogs gshed mas ring du bdas// stag ldan nags su 'jigs pa thub pas bskyabs// rig pas rgyal srid thob pa snyan dngags mkhan// tshong 67 pa lnga brgya 'tsho phyir lag 'gro'i grangs// rang nyid mchongs pas ma nongs tshur rol 'gram// dge sdig 'bras bu la bltas drang srong tshogs// 'phags lam 'dren pa'i shing rta dge 'dun bsrung*// rkang 68 bkod padma bzhad pa mda' lnga'i gzugs// tshangs byin gyis thob zung gi bur btsas kyang*// phrag dog btsun mos bsgribs pas khrims la sbyar// bden mtha' nya pas mngon bstan padma ldan// bde 69 gshegs ring bsrel snying po'i mchod pa'i rten// brgyad khri bzhi stong bskrun pa dgra bcom mchog /rdzu 'phrul nam mkhar 'phags pa'i grib bsil g.yob// mchod sbyin zla bral chos rgyal rab gnas grags// kha 70 che'i yul gshegs gdug pa'i klu btul nas// skyil krung gcig khyab sa chen phul ba la// gtsug lag khang bcas dge 'dun dpag yas bskrun// gur gum tshal gyis mdzes byed nyi ma gung*// bcom 71 brlag yul gyi mgo chen ri bo la// skyil mo krung bcas gegs byed klu btul nas// gar mkhan dpa' bo'i gtsug lag khang mchog brtsigs// rgyal bstan rnam par rgyas mdzad sha na'i gos// srid 72 pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal chos 'doms tshe// gzhan blo 'drid pa'i yid srubs dgrol dka' ba'i// mi sdug cha lugs bsgyur bas skyabs su bsten// bde gshegs rnam par sprul bcug nye sbas so// chu

73 gter byings pa'i nor phyir rgyal po'i bka'// bsod nams mang bsags je mthor phyin pa na// gdengs can tshogs kyis gtsug blangs dbyig gi dpya// phrag par bkod de bcal ba klur springs yig / 74 mchod sbyin yul gyur mtha' dag mkho dgu'i dpal// ches cher phul ba'i mya ngan med pa de// mtho ris bgrod pa nye tshe lhas bskos kyi// dpung pas bsrungs pa'i ma lus sa gzhi phul// ma 75 rig rtsa ba sbom pos 'khrul snang gi /yal ga 'khyog por bskyed pa 'khor ba'i shing*// de rgyu snga ma 'gags pas phyir rnams kyi// spros pa zhi ston rten cing 'brel 'byung chos// skyon 76 bral lus bcad 'bras bu dmus long gzugs// mgo mjug khyab par rma skyes srin bu'i tshogs// za ba'i sdug bsngal cho nge 'byin ma zad// da dung mnar 'gyur lung bstan bi du raḥ /mi 77 mchog chu klung dal gyis 'bab ngogs su// rgyal chen rnam bzhis chos thob song ba'i rjes// thub pa zung zhig legs gsungs 'dul bar bsten// bden mthong rnam par grol ba kai ne ya// bcom 78 ldan me khams snyoms zhugs sad byas te// 'chi 'pho'i mtshan nyid kyis skrag skabs gsum bdag /skyabs su song la lam bstan yongs ltung 'phral// stan der gsar 'khrungs brgya byin ltung ba'i gtam// snying rjes 79 rgyal srid btang bas dgra sde dga'// rang lus dgra la btsong bas slong ba dga'// ngo mtshar rgyal thabs thob pas 'khor 'bangs dga'// dbang chen sde de 'tsho bde'i sngon gyi rabs// ku 80 na gzigs tha ma'i gzims khri la bzhugs tshe// ye shes gzigs pas gdul bya'i lhag ma zung*// nyer dgongs thabs kyis legs btul rgyun zhugs bkod// ston pa'i sngon du myang 'das rab bzang che// don 81 mthun ring nas gsol btab thugs rje yis// 'jigs bral rgyal ba'i sku la tsanda na'i// byug pa phul bas snyun gdangs dpal kun thob// 'tshang rgya 'gyur bar lung bstan rgyu yi mchog

/ 82 'dod log spyod pa 'gog byed ma yi mgo /ral gris bregs pa'i 'gyod pas rab byung ba// srid pa'i go cha dus kyis dmyal ba cher// lhung las thon pas bden mthong dmyal sngon ldan// skyed 83 mos tshal du zhag drug thu bo bcings// ljid che dar ba'i bum pa bgres mo la// rgyang grags drug bkal 'bras bu grags 'dzin mngal// zla drug sbrum pa sgra gcan 'dzin gyi rabs// skyes 84 tsam rin chen khrir 'khod chu 'dzin gyis// sbrang rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebs pa'i skal ldan des// bde gshegs mchod de 'dul bar rab tu byung*// chom rkun lnga brgya bcas grol sbrang rtsi'i dbyangs// rang 85 lus khrag gis gzhan gyi nad bsos shing*// bdag nyid bro 'tshal tshegs kyis bsgrub pa'i sman// rang rgyal snyun gyis thebs la 'phul ba'i mthus// gnyis ka nad med thob pa phan pa 'tshol// na 86 gas su dge lam mi skad 'doms pa'i grogs// ri bong yal ga'i ri dwags gnyis 'thung bcas// rgan rim phu dud bslab gzhi legs blangs pas// yul phyogs shis pa'i dpal bskyed ba men mched// 87 bag yod tshul khrims bslab pa lhur blangs pa// 'gugs byed sngags kyi shing rtas drangs gyur kyang*// chags pa'i yul las me nang 'jug spro bas// sprul 'tshong grogs bcas bsil ba padma can// yid 88 'byung gsar pas rab byung blangs te slar// mdza' gcugs 'jo sgeg zhags pas khyim du bcings// phan mdzad rgyal ba'i snang bas gtsang byas te// chags bral bkod pa nag pa glang chen stan// ma 89 thar byed chu srin rab rngams gdangs pa'i kha// sangs rgyas mtshan gyis zums bzhin 'phos pas deng*// rab byung zas kyi phung pos ma tshim pa// sngon gyi rus pa mthong grol chos srid grags// lhas 90 bskos mchis 'brang bu dang mna' mar bcas// rab dang sems kyis mchod 'os shākya thub// dge 'dun bcas pa spyan drangs gdugs bzhir mchod// chos bstan bden pa mthong ba nor can sde// 'bod grogs

91 mgul ba'i rin chen rgyud mangs las// tshigs bcad phyed pa'i glu blangs lhag ma'i yon// rang lus sha khrag mchod pas bstabs pa'i mthar// 'gyod bral bden pas bsos pa shi bi'i rgyal// drin du 92 che ba skyed byed dam ma'i mgor// rkang rtses bsnun rtags spyi bo mtshon chas bcom// 'gyod kyin gzhan phan blo yis sgrib byang nas// dga' ldan lhar skyes mdza' bo'i bu mor grags// mchod 93 yul dman pas yid skyo shing 'phel du// spyan 'dren gsol btab sang gi mkha' lam nas// bde gshegs 'khor bcas kyis byon dad pa'i gzhir// dam chos dar rkyen ma ga dha bzang mo// bsod 94 nams lhan cig skyes pa mche ba'i chu// bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin btung bas srid pa'i dpal// yongs spangs thub pa'i mchog las rab byung ba// sred pa'i rdul bral las bzang grags pa'i bshes// bkres 95 rngabs drag pos brdar ba'i mche ba dag /rang gi phru gu la gtsigs bza' nye ba// snying rje'i rdul gyis rang lus der btang bas// ma smad yongs kyi srog bsrungs stag mo'i gtam// 96 mya ngam thang du 'phyan pa lnga brgya'i blon// bkres skom nyam thag brtse ba'i sna lag gis// nyer blangs chu yis dbugs phyung rang gi lus// g.yang sar mchongs te byin pa glang po bzang*// chu 97 gter don mthun bying ba rang gi rgyab// rnam bkod pha rol bsgral mthar ngal ba'i lus// gnyid du yur skabs gor ma'i char phab kyang*// ma nongs lus kyi sbyin btang rus sbal che// de bzhin 98 gshegs pas gyad ltogs zas kyis bstabs// dge lam bstan pas dgra bcom grub pa'i rgyu// sngon tshe drang srong tshogs la nges legs lam// nyer bstan dge ba'i ngang tshul dka' thub pa// 99 gzhan srog 'tsho ba'i sman mchog rnyed dka'i phyir// ba gam ngos rtse las mchongs ro hi tar// skye bar smon lam btab 'phral skyes pa'i nya'i// sha khrag sman gyis nad bsos padma can// bcom

100 ldan zhal gyi chu skyes 'dzum dbus nas// byang chub mchog tu thog ma'i sems bskyed gtam// sbrang rtsi'i ro bda' stsal ba gsal rgyal gyis// blo yi bung bas gzhibs de rab gsal dus// nags 101 su chu bum thogs pa'i gzhon nu de// lam du nyag phran phog kyang pha ma yi// rim gro bral ba'i gdung bas snying zugs pa// brgya byin sman gyis bsos pa sngo bsangs can// 102 dag byed 'gram du don mthun tshogs za ba'i// sbrul gdug chen pos bskor ba yongs bskyab phyir// gnyis 'thung steng nas langs pa'i sder mo yis// bcom ste srog gsum dor ba gdong lnga pa// lhan 103 skyes gdugs kyi grib mar lha mi'i dpal// dbang du 'byor la blo ngan blon po dgrar// ldang bas ma mes dmag gi dpung bskul yang*// phan sems kyis bsdams dga' ba'i gong bur grags// rtsa 104 ba 'bras bu'i 'tsho ba yongs bskams pas// thub pa bsod snyoms grong du 'jug brtsam pa// rang lus bstab phyir zhugs su mchongs chas pas// dka' thub phyir zhing brtan byed ri bong grogs// thab 105 tu chos gos shing shun gyis 'tshod pa// gnyis skyes be'u stor ba'i sha khrag tu// sngon las kyis sbrul btson du ring bcings mtha'// skyon bral mngon sum thob pa rai ba ta// 106 skyed byed khros pas yul spyugs nyag phran gyis// gnod sbyin gcig gi lhag byas blon po'i bu// mi bdag la bkod rang nyid pha yi srid// skyong ba'i cod paṇa bcings de gser go cha// legs 107 lam thams cad snyan pa'i glu len mas// yid dbang rab phrogs bcu gnyis lor bsgrubs pa'i// rin chen yon gyis dbyangs can mgrin pa las// legs bshad ci 'dod 'jo ba zas gtsang ma// pha ma 108 nags khrod dong ba'i rjes 'khyams pas// ma la ya can rtse dga' rjes dran yang*// klu phrug tshab tu rang lus mkha' lding byin// gau rī'i chu rgyun gyis bsos sprin gyi bzhon// de skad mkhyen brtse'i 'khor lo sngon 'gro ma'i// rjes su rmad byung spyod pa'i dpung bgrod pas// 'gro don bsgrubs pa'i rtogs brjod chig brgya brgyad// bdag nyid nyi ma'i rgyud 'khrungs la phyag 'tshal// sgo gsum dge ba longs spyod zhing kun du// mchod pa'i sprin gyis khyab par sprul te dbul// thog med 'khor bar rang bzhin bcas sdig gi

/dri ma bshung 'gyod skal ldan shing rtas bkru// 'phags dang so skye'i legs byas kha ba'i rdul// brtsegs la yi rang zla ba'i 'od kyis bklubs// mi mchog myang 'das gzhol na bskal sngon gyi// smon lam yi ge gsubs la mi 'gyod dam// ma rig gnyid la yur ba'i lus can rnams// dam chos gling bu snyan pas sad par mdzod// dus gsum dge ba'i phung po bdag dang gzhan// bde gshegs spyod pa'i rjes su 'jug phyir bsngo// //yang smras pa/ bskal pa bzang po'i legs bris lam 'di mdzes byed pa// chos kyi ma bzlums bzhi pa shar ba'i rtogs pa brjod// sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rab rgyas tshal gyi bcud 'thungs pas// tshig sbyor rkang pa drug pa rgyags pa'i glu 'di blangs// rnam dkar dge bas yang 'byung srid pa kun du bdag /rten du dal 'byor rdzogs par tshul khrims bslab pas gtsang*// phyi nang gtsug lag la 'jug rnam dpyod ches gsal ba'i// mkhas tshul gsum gyi phrin las 'jig rten 'bar gyur cig /sa bdag ltos bcas kyis mtshon sems can thams cad la// rgyal ba'i thugs rjes byin gyis brlabs kyi 'bab stegs byas// de nas brtsams te sgrib pa kun gyis stongs pa'i rgyud// dge ba'i tshogs rab bla nas bla mar 'phel gyur cig /ces rgyal ba'i rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing gi yal 'dab kyi grangs dang mnyam par yal 'dab re re'i brjod bya rnams shlau ka rer bsdebs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rin chen don 'dus zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gser ldan lus phra'i bzhin ras yangs par dbang gi mnga' mdzad/ dpal sde dge sa skyong bla ma chen po lcam dral nas lha khang du rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi bkod pa ldebs ris su bzhengs pa'i skabs/ bzo gnas rig pa'i gtsug lag smra ba bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas sug bris su bgyis pa bkra shis rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig

/sarba maṅga laṃ// ༄// na maḥshākya mu na ye/ 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng gi yi// mdzad pa'i gtso las byung ba'i mchod rten brgyad// sku bltams mchod rten pad spungs ser skyar byung*// rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i byang chen ma ga dhār// chos 'khor bskor ba'i sgo mangs 'khor mo 'jig /cho 'phrul bstan pa'i cho 'phrul mnyan yod du// lha gnas las bab lha babs gsal ldan grong*// dge 'dun dbyen bsdum byams dngos rgyal po'i khab// sku tshe byin rlabs rnam rgyal yangs pa can// mdzad pa tha ma'i myang 'das rtswa can du// legs byung mchod rten brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod// dge bas thams cad gzigs pa'i sku thob shog /ces de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten chen po brgyad kyi bstod pa nyung ngu don 'dus 'di'ang*/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng du bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
